item.title: Don't Rely on Google Maps Alone in Korea: Naver Map & KakaoMap Guide (2026)
item.description: A map app is one of the first things to set up before a trip to Korea. In most countries Google Maps is all you need, but in Korea it’s much easier with Naver Map or KakaoMap installed as well. Here’s what you need to know. (As of November 5, 2026)
